fields.description: Verve City Walk comprises two residential towers linked by a podium and retail setting along Al Safa Street. One- to four-bedroom apartments are joined by a five-bedroom duplex penthouse, while selected cut-out layouts offer double-height spaces and substantial terraces.

overview: Podium leisure facilities are complemented by higher-level cut-out spaces and selected double-height homes. Access to an exclusive terrace or lounge should be checked against the selected unit rather than assumed for every apartment.
The duplex penthouse’s size repeats on both floor drawings: it is a whole-home total. Balcony and terrace components form part of the advertised saleable area.
research.locationNote: Along Al Safa Street in City Walk, Dubai. The brochure places the homes near the district’s retail, dining and entertainment; actual walking routes, noise exposure and views depend on tower and orientation.
research.priceNote: The official sheet lists AED 2.12 m one bedroom; 2.90 m two; 4.21 m “2+ Bedroom”; 5.50 m three; 8.75 m large three; 12.1 m four; 29.52 m penthouse. These are historical launch guides, not current inventory or a unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: Official schedule: 20% booking; 10% November 2024; 5% March 2025; 10% August 2025; 10% January 2026; 10% June 2026; 10% November 2026; 25% July 2028 handover. Obtain actual paid/remaining balances; past dates are not a new buyer’s future calendar.
research.handoverNote: The official payment sheet estimates July 2028. Property Finder’s headline gives September 2028 while its FAQ retains July. Confirm the contract’s tower and completion date.
